name: Selvala's Stampede
clause: Reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card for each wild vote. Put those creature cards onto the battlefield, then shuffle the rest into your library.

needs.proposedSignature: { op: 'reveal-until'; filter: Filter; count: Amount; who?: ScopeWho; found: PileFate; rest: PileFate } — reveal from the top of the library until `count` cards matching `filter` have been revealed (or the library runs out), then apply `found` to those and `rest` to everything else revealed; binds the found cards as `those`
needs.semantics: 'Reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card for each wild vote. Put those creature cards onto the battlefield, then shuffle the rest into your library.' Every existing look/dig op reads a FIXED number of cards, so an unbounded search of the library top with a per-card stopping condition cannot be written.
